summary: Jianzhi Education Technology Group filed a Form 6-K announcing an ADS ratio change from 1 ADS:60 ordinary shares to 1 ADS:1,800 ordinary shares, effective July 6, 2026. This acts as a reverse ADS split, consolidating every 30 existing ADSs into 1 new ADS, reducing outstanding ADSs from 32,090,832 to ~1,069,695. The depositary is Bank of New York Mellon. No underlying ordinary shares change. The move aims to raise ADS trading price to comply with Nasdaq listing requirements. No premium, price, or board recommendation. Watch for Nasdaq compliance and post-split trading liquidity.
